method: Actual Ruffle original numerical states and mouse controls; in-memory read-only observer

results.scope: Actual original Ruffle startup and successive numerical histories; original min/mid/max charge and field sliders, sign toggles, charge dragging, magnet boundary dragging including the >400 jump to 300, automatic motion, coil positions and meter/force gate response. Coordinate comparisons allow original 0.05 px (one twip) quantization. All continuous mouse paths and event orders remain unexhausted.
